name: Foundation Future Industries
talks: CNBC reported the CEO has been trying since at least January to raise hundreds of millions of dollars at a USD 3B valuation; the company is short of cash.

name: Skylark Labs
talks: Livemint reported the company is in talks to raise USD 100-150M at a valuation above USD 1B; later reports said about 70% was committed.

name: Irregular
talks: Calcalist (following Globes) reported Irregular is raising more than USD 100M at a USD 1.5B valuation, led by Thrive Capital and Greenoaks; terms not final.

name: Emulate (AI lab)
talks: FT reported Emulate in advanced talks to raise up to USD 700M in a seed round led by Index Ventures and Lightspeed, with Creandum, at USD 3.7B; Bloomberg said USD 3B before new funds.
talks_outlet: Financial Times / Bloomberg (as cited by The Next Web)

name: Discovery Loop
talks: Business Insider reported Discovery Loop in talks to raise USD 1B at about USD 10B (Aug 2026), then talks to raise again at around USD 50B (Sep 2026), citing people familiar.
talks_outlet: Business Insider (as cited by AI Weekly and Dealroom)

name: New York Islanders
talks: Sportico reported the Islanders agreed to sell roughly 15% of shares at a USD 3B valuation; the team declined comment and NHL approval is pending.

name: TMRW Sports
talks: Front Office Sports reported TMRW Sports is finalizing a new funding round that would value it at more than USD 1B, about double its 2024 Series A value; Dynasty Equity expected to take part.

name: Cleveland Cavaliers
talks: MT Newswires reported Blue Owl Capital in advanced talks to buy a 5%-10% minority stake in the Cavaliers; valuation not given in the visible report.

name: Orbicular Pharmaceutical Technologies
talks: Mint reported Warburg Pincus and CVC eyeing a stake in Orbicular in a deal valuing it at USD 1-1.5B; Jefferies advising, existing backer Tata Capital Healthcare Fund may exit.

name: Parfums de Marly
talks: Reuters reported, citing two people familiar, that Advent is exploring a sale with CVC, Cinven and Puig among suitors; one source put the value below EUR 2B.

name: Arthea (formerly PDC Brands)
talks: Reuters reported, citing sources, that owner CVC is exploring a sale of Arthea that could value it at around USD 2B; talks at an early stage.

name: Crystal Palace FC
talks: City AM reported, citing multiple sources, that Palace's owners value the club at GBP 900M and hired Raine Group to field interest in investment or a possible sale.

name: Everton FC
talks: The FT reported Everton's owners were looking for investors; Sky Sports later said The Friedkin Group hopes for upwards of GBP 1B in a sale.
talks_outlet: Financial Times / Sky Sports (via Goodison News)

name: LaserAway
talks: Reuters reported, citing people familiar, that Ares-backed LaserAway is exploring a sale that could value the medical spa chain at more than USD 2B.

name: True Religion
talks: Reuters reported, citing sources, that ACON-owned True Religion is exploring options including a full or minority stake sale valuing it at close to USD 1B, with JPMorgan advising.

name: Javvy
talks: Reuters reported, citing sources, that Javvy is exploring a sale that could value it at around USD 1B as demand for protein products grows.

name: Dose
talks: Reuters reported, citing people familiar, that Dose is exploring a sale with Perella Weinberg that could value it at close to USD 1B; investors include Unilever Ventures.

name: Brunt Workwear
talks: Reuters reported, citing sources, that Brunt Workwear is exploring a full sale or strategic investment that could value the private company at over USD 1B.

name: Rawlings Sporting Goods
talks: Bloomberg reported Seidler Equity is exploring a sale of its 75% stake in Rawlings, seeking a valuation of about USD 2B including debt; Octus later said Partners Group was among interested sponsors.

name: Custom Ink
talks: Reuters reported, citing people familiar, that Custom Ink is exploring a sale that could value it at close to USD 1.5B.

name: Discovery Senior Living
talks: Reuters reported, citing people familiar, that the owners of Discovery Senior Living are exploring a sale that could value it at more than USD 1B.

name: SuKarne
talks: Reuters reported, citing people familiar, that SuKarne's owner is exploring a sale that could value the company at over USD 2B.

name: Iconix International
talks: WWD reported, citing sources, that Iconix hired J.P. Morgan to find a buyer in a sale that could be worth about USD 1B.

name: AIG Hospitals
talks: The Economic Times reported Novo Holdings, GIC and Axight in talks to invest Rs 2,000-2,500 crore in AIG Hospitals as founders pare 10-12% at a Rs 24,000 crore valuation.

name: Airlogix
talks: Forbes reported, citing two sources, that Airlogix is in talks to raise USD 100M at a valuation above USD 2B; the company declined to comment.

name: Pyra
talks: The Financial Times (via Sifted) reported that Pyra, founded by Nick Blair, is seeking about USD 200M; terms under discussion and could change.

name: Destinus
talks: Bloomberg reported Destinus seeks about EUR 200M (about USD 232M at ~1.16) in pre-IPO funding at a valuation above EUR 5B, advised by Rothschild and UniCredit, ahead of a possible Amsterdam listing.
